about:
# Halo

Radial menus for WoW Forever: hold a key, point at a slice, let go to use it.

## Install

Put the `Halo` folder in `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.

## Use

- `/halo`, the minimap icon or the **Open Halo** key (Options) opens the window. Starter rings: Supplies, Travel, Emotes.
- **New ring**, then set a **Key** or **Gamepad** button.
- Drop spells, items, mounts, toys, pets or macros on the ring. **+** adds emotes, markers, lists, other rings, macros.
- Drag a slice to move it. Drag the ring to turn it. Right-click removes a slice.
- A ring holds 12 slices. Automatic lists fill what is left.
- Gamepad layers: give a ring R3, another R3 + L1. Hold L1 in the R3 ring to switch, or hold L1, then press R3.
- Emote icons: three sets in Options (Drawn, Engraved, Line).
- **Fishing pole** (in **+**): one press, your best pole from the bags; the next, back to your weapons. The same swap as Gamepad Companion's.
- Gamepad bar combos (R1 + D-pad): **...** → **Make macro**, put it on that slot.
- Works in combat. Ring changes made in combat apply after.

| Input | Action |
|---|---|
| Hold key, release on slice | Use |
| Release in the middle | Ring stays open |
| Click, or 1-9, 0 | Use |
| Right-click | Back |
| Esc | Close |
| Gamepad: stick, then release or A, L1, R1, L2, R2 | Use |
| Gamepad: B | Back or close |

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `/halo layout a` · `b` | Window layout |
| `/halo reset yes` | Delete all rings and options |
| `/halo status` · `debug` · `camstate` | Diagnostics |

## Data

`WTF\Account\<account>\SavedVariables\Halo.lua` (`HaloDB`).

## Tests

```
lua5.1 tests/Smoke.lua
```

## More

[docs/Details.md](https://github.com/Mimezu/forever-Halo/blob/main/docs/Details.md): styles, folders, automatic lists, how it works.

releases.name: Halo 0.9.42
releases.notes:
Unzip into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.

Changes since 0.9.32:

### 0.9.42 — 2026-11-25

- Ring keys stay bound and are only rewritten, never all cleared and bound again: rebinding could pick up another addon's leftover gamepad function (Mute ran Focus UI)

### 0.9.41 — 2026-11-21

- **Trinket 1** and **Trinket 2** in **+** › Automatic: a slice that uses whatever trinket you wear in that slot, with its icon and cooldown (like Gamepad Companion's)

### 0.9.40 — 2026-11-20

- Fixed: a pad button held when a ring opened, then let go, raised an error ("Cannot call restricted closure from insecure code") instead of going back to the ring

### 0.9.39 — 2026-11-20

- Open Halo keycap shares the key tables with the ring keycaps
- Loot, mounts and zones no longer rebind ring keys or rebuild rings when nothing changed

### 0.9.38 — 2026-11-20

- Fixed: hold R2, press R3, let both go: the R2 ring stayed on screen but the R3 ring's slice was used. A ring opened on a layer (second button held first) now stays that ring until it closes

### 0.9.37 — 2026-11-20

- Fixed: hold R2, press R3, use a slice: Blizzard's bar stayed on its R2 page after R2 was let go. A pad button already held when a ring opens is no longer bound by the ring, so its release reaches the game. Once let go, the ring takes it back (at once out of combat, at the next ring input in combat), and a layer button let go returns to the opening ring

### 0.9.36 — 2026-11-20

- Fixed: Blizzard's R2 bar stopped switching. A gamepad chord's second button (R2, L1...) no longer runs through Halo's relay: holding it, then pressing the ring's button, is read from the pad itself at the press, so R2 and L1 stay the game's own. Keyboard chords keep the relay

### 0.9.35 — 2026-11-20

- **Fishing pole**, a new slice (**+** › Fishing pole): one press puts your best fishing pole from the bags in your hands, the next puts back the weapons you held (main hand and off hand). Several poles: the best you can use. No pole: a short note, nothing else happens
- The swap is shared with Gamepad Companion (Choose › Quick use › Fishing pole): one file, `MimezuFishing.lua`, ships in both addons and the newest copy loaded runs. Each addon remembers your weapons per character, so either works alone
- It works in combat too: the macro's conditions (`[equipped:Fishing Poles]`) pick the way at the press. Its pole and weapons are re-read when your bags or hands change, out of combat

releases.name: Halo 0.9.32
releases.notes:
Unzip into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.

### Fixed
- Blizzard gamepad windows keep their buttons: R3 sets the amount while crafting
- A ring takes its button back when the window closes

releases.name: Halo 0.9.31
releases.notes:
Unzip into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.

### New
- Drag the ring's background to turn the whole ring
- Key binding to open Halo, minimap icon, Settings page entry

### Fixed
- Equipment set slices show the set's own icon
- The worn equipment set lights up on the ring

releases.name: Halo 0.9.28
releases.notes:
Unzip into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.

### New
- Gamepad layers: R3 + L1 ring shows while L1 is held in the R3 ring
- Drag slices to move them on the ring
- Window layout B, switch in the footer
- One food slice, one drink slice (drink for mana classes)
- One best usable bandage slice

### Changed
- Shorter text in the window, tooltips and messages
- Hand-placed slices keep their place in a full ring
- Gamepad Companion can rumble on slice changes
